author: Written by the same AI assistant that wrote agent-v1; not reviewed by a human.
labeling_policy: Labels constrain only outcome-critical behaviour: which T2 action is proposed (or none), which write or T2 tools must not be called, and a read tool only when the answer cannot be correct without it.
Process-only steps (for example calling rank_quotes, or calling read tools before asking a clarifying question) are not required; agent-v1 labels required some of them.
Clarification and out-of-scope cases pass when no write or T2 tool is called and nothing is proposed.
run_rules: Prompt and tool-description changes may only use agent-v1 results.
The first live run of agent-v2 after tuning is the reported result; it is not re-run to pick a better score.
Labels are never changed after the first run; later runs are reported as regression runs.
